weakness: Client A gateway sessions run from a mixed-use administrator laptop over the shared home Wi-Fi with a browser-saved password
remediation_plan: Written connection rules (POL-01 6.4); password manager; phone hotspot for every session until the business network exists; delete the browser password store
milestones: 2026-09-15 password manager in use and browser store deleted; 2026-09-30 rules in use for the next gateway window
resources_required: Password manager about $40 a year; owner time

weakness: Daily work in the laptop administrator account
remediation_plan: Create a standard daily account; keep the administrator account for installs only

weakness: No MFA on the accounting SaaS or the Client B platform account
remediation_plan: Turn on MFA on both; unique passphrases

weakness: USB backup drive with CEII and client files is not encrypted
source: P07 assessment (SC-28; CP-09d.[01]); P03 G-006, G-021
remediation_plan: Replace with an encrypted drive; crypto-erase and destroy the old drive with a record
milestones: 2026-09-30 encrypted drive in use and old drive destroyed

weakness: Monthly backup only; model files and CEII archive not synced; first restore test found 2 empty files; one copy kept beside the laptop
remediation_plan: Weekly encrypted backup with verification; export software settings; quarterly restore test; second encrypted drive kept off site at the owner's attorney's office
milestones: 2026-09-30 weekly backup and second drive; 2026-12-31 first quarterly restore test passed
resources_required: Second drive about $150; owner time (1 hour a month)

weakness: Backup drive not in the locked cabinet and taken to the field; former client's 2025 drawings still held
source: P07 assessment (MP-04a.[01], MP-04a.[03], MP-04b.); P03 G-015
remediation_plan: Drive kept in the locked cabinet and never taken to the field; shred the 2025 drawings and send the former client a certificate; client information register
milestones: 2026-09-30 drive stored correctly; 2026-10-31 certificate sent and register in use

weakness: No internal reporting time or notification list
source: P07 assessment (IR-06a., IR-06b.); P03 G-014, G-025, G-033
remediation_plan: Adopt the P08 runbook and notification matrix; printed contact sheet in the home office and field bag; walkthrough with the IT technician
milestones: 2026-08-31 runbook adopted; 2026-09-30 contacts printed and walkthrough done

weakness: Vendors and helpers hold client data with no review or agreement; no vendor list
source: P07 assessment (SA-09 objectives); P03 G-016, G-031
remediation_plan: Vendor list; photo sync off and cloud copies deleted; keep the AI vendor deletion confirmation; field assistant agreement, briefing, and deletion of the Client B photos
milestones: 2026-09-15 photo sync off; 2026-09-30 vendor list and AI confirmation filed; 2026-10-31 field assistant agreement signed

weakness: No review of sign-in history and no own gateway session log
remediation_plan: Session log on the phone for each gateway window; monthly suite sign-in review; answer Client A's weekly review within one business day; review weekly for 3 months after any incident
milestones: 2026-10-01 first monthly review; 2026-10-31 session log in use
